newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Afghanistan's Rabbani in neighbouring Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: Afghanistan's Rabbani in neighbouring Tajikistan.

text.p: Ousted Afghan President Burhanuddin Rabbani is in neighbouring Tajikistan after the Taleban militia took the northern Afghan town of Mazar-i-Sharif last week, an official close to Rabbani said on Monday.

"Rabbani and several members of his cabinet are now in the town of Kulyab in Tajikistan's south," the source told Reuters by telephone from the Tajik capital Dushanbe. He did not say when Rabbani arrived. Rabbani was driven from the Afghan capital Kabul by the purist Islamic Taleban militia last September.
